question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs, COUNT(DISTINCT bs.match_id) as matches_with_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id 
      AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id 
      AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
      AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON bs.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT wt.player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN match m ON wt.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY wt.player_out
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       ROUND(1.0 * pr.total_runs / pm.matches_played, 2) as avg_runs_per_match,
       ROUND(CASE WHEN COALESCE(pd.dismissals, 0) > 0 
            THEN 1.0 * pr.total_runs / pd.dismissals 
            ELSE NULL 
       END, 2) as batting_average
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN player_matches pm ON pr.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN player p ON pr.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON pr.player_id = pd.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5
